---
name: vscode-tool-evaluation
description: Evaluate and recommend VS Code extensions, MCP servers, and developer tools using compatibility, publisher identity, maintenance, security, licensing, and task-fit evidence.
---

# VS Code Tool Evaluation

1. Clarify the user's task, platform, VS Code version, local/remote host, and any licensing or organizational constraints.
2. Prefer official VS Code documentation, Microsoft-maintained projects, or established publishers when the task warrants them; do not treat popularity or download counts as proof of safety.
3. Verify publisher identity, exact extension/package identifier, supported VS Code/Node versions, permissions, repository, release history, license, issue activity, and known security advisories.
4. Compare the candidate with built-in VS Code features and installed tools before recommending an additional dependency.
5. Separate verified facts from assumptions and date-sensitive observations. Provide evidence links and tradeoffs.
6. Do not install or enable a recommendation without approval for the target environment.
